title: SparVAR: Exploring Sparsity in Visual AutoRegressive Modeling for Training-Free Acceleration
abstract: arXiv:2602.04361v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Visual AutoRegressive (VAR) modeling has garnered significant attention for its innovative next-scale prediction paradigm. However, mainstream VAR paradigms attend to all tokens across historical scales at each autoregressive step. As the next scale resolution grows, the computational complexity of attention increases quartically with resolution, causing substantial latency. Prior accelerations often skip high-resolution scales, which speeds up inference but discards high-frequency details and harms image quality. To address these problems, we present SparVAR, a training-free acceleration framework that exploits three properties of VAR attention: (i) strong attention sinks, (ii) cross-scale activation similarity, and (iii) pronounced locality. translated_title: SparVAR：探索视觉自回归建模中的稀疏性以实现免训练加速
translated_abstract: 视觉自回归建模因其创新性的“下一尺度预测”范式而受到广泛关注。然而，主流的VAR范式在每个自回归步骤中都会关注所有历史尺度的全部token。随着下一尺度分辨率的增大，注意力的计算复杂度随分辨率呈四次方增长，造成显著的推理延迟。以往的加速方法通常跳过高分辨率尺度，这虽然加快了推理速度，但丢弃了高频细节并损害了图像质量。为解决这些问题，我们提出了SparVAR，一个免训练的加速框架，它利用了VAR注意力的三个特性：（i）强注意力汇聚点，（ii）跨尺度激活相似性，以及（iii）显著的局部性。具体而言，我们从稀疏决策尺度动态预测后续高分辨率尺度的稀疏注意力模式，并通过高效的方法构建尺度自相似的稀疏注意力。
tldr: SparVAR是一种免训练的VAR模型加速框架，通过利用注意力汇聚点、跨尺度激活相似性和局部性三大特性，从稀疏决策尺度动态预测高分辨率尺度的稀疏注意力模式，在不跳过尺度、不牺牲图像质量的前提下大幅降低计算复杂度和推理延迟。
en_tdlr: SparVAR is a training-free acceleration framework for VAR models that dynamically predicts sparse attention patterns for high-resolution scales by exploiting strong attention sinks, cross-scale activation similarity, and locality, substantially reducing computational complexity and latency without skipping scales or sacrificing image quality.
